info.description: Workout session manager and weight tracker. Sessions prescribe the plan; workouts record what actually happened in the gym.

googleClientId.description: The Google OAuth client id native sign-in must use as ID-token audience; null on single-user instances.

idToken.description: A Google ID token obtained on-device (Credential Manager), audience = this instance's Google client id.

deviceName.description: Label for the minted device token, shown in web settings.

token.description: The bearer token cleartext (kr_…). Returned exactly once; only its hash is stored.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag handed to Intl and reka for number/date formatting (fr-FR, en-FR, en-US, en-GB, de-DE), or null to follow the device locale. Validated server-side against the supported set.

aliases.description: Alternative names the picker searches besides `name`. Gained via merges and the seeded catalog; not editable through the input payload.

ExerciseBestSet.description: The heaviest set ever logged for an exercise, tie-broken by reps at that load.

sessions.description: Session templates that program this exercise.

history.description: Workouts that logged this exercise, newest first.

best.description: Null when the exercise was never performed with a logged load.

ExerciseUsage.description: Where an exercise is still referenced — carried by the delete 409 so clients can hand over to the merge flow.

targetId.description: The surviving exercise. The source's references re-point to it and its names live on as aliases.

reps.description: The rep target. Null is an open target: reps are decided at workout time.

position.description: Rotation order inside a superset entry.

SessionEntry.description: The top-level ordered unit of a session. One exercise = plain exercise; several = superset rotated through back-to-back.

reps.description: Anything non-positive normalises to null — an open target.

ids.description: Every session id exactly once, in the new order.

sessionId.description: The session this workout was started from; null once that template is deleted.

TemplateChange.description: One way a workout's tree differs from its template, keyed by exercise so a client can render names from its catalog. 'sets'/'reps' carry the workout's value plus the template's ('was'); 'reordered' is a catch-all order/grouping change. 'reps' deltas are observational — an Update keeps the template's prescribed reps.

count.description: Set count on the workout side (kind 'sets').

was.description: Template's set count (kind 'sets') or prescribed reps (kind 'reps', null when open).

reps.description: Workout's reps at that set (kind 'reps', null when open).

TemplateStatus.description: A workout's link to its source template: identity, whether its structure has diverged (gates the sync-back affordance), and the itemised changes for the diff view. 'changes' may include rep deltas even when 'diverged' is false, since reps alone never count as structural drift.

template.description: Recomputed against the just-persisted tree, so clients track divergence without a follow-up read.

sessionId.description: The session template to copy. Rep targets seed each set; open targets seed from the last logged reps.

weight.description: Kilograms; negative or non-finite values normalise to null.

name.description: Only applied when non-empty; otherwise the name snapshot stays untouched.

mode.description: `update` rewrites the source template in place; `create` makes a new template and re-points the workout at it.

date.description: The calendar day weighed (YYYY-MM-DD), one weigh-in per user and day.

ApiError.description: h3 error payload. `data` rides along for clients that branch on the cause (e.g. the exercise delete 409 carries ExerciseUsage under `data.usage`).
